D1.title: Tip alignment changes
D1.description: The screwdriver shifts relative to the screw head during this brief dip, then continues positioning over the fastener.
D1.cameraHint: Compare cam_1 and cam_2 for the tip-to-screw alignment.

D2.title: Another small repositioning
D2.description: A second change in tool-to-screw alignment accompanies the dip. The close views reveal motion that is subtle in the wider view.
D2.cameraHint: Use cam_1 to inspect the screw head; cam_2 adds the surrounding context.

D3.title: Tool-to-screw pose change
D3.description: The screw head moves relative to the tool tip between the peak and trough. This short repositioning coincides with the largest score drop in this episode.
D3.cameraHint: Compare peak and trough in cam_1, then check the tool pose in cam_2.

D1.title: Approach adjustment
D1.description: The card stays in the gripper as its pose changes above the motherboard. The small dip accompanies this adjustment during approach.
D1.cameraHint: Use cam_2 for card-to-board position and cam_1 for the held card.

D2.title: Fine alignment near the slot
D2.description: The card makes a subtle pose adjustment near the slot. Compare the peak and trough to see the small change in card-to-board alignment.
D2.cameraHint: Compare cam_1 and cam_2; the change is subtle in cam_0.

D3.title: Extended pose correction
D3.description: The card shifts relative to the motherboard over a longer interval, then moves back toward its earlier pose. The progress estimate falls during this correction.
D3.cameraHint: Use cam_2 to follow the card edge and cam_1 to compare alignment.

D1.title: Lift-off transition
D1.description: The gripper lifts the dark plate from the tabletop. The score briefly falls during the transition from grasping to transport.
D1.cameraHint: Use cam_0 to see lift-off and cam_2 to inspect the grasp.

D2.title: Aligning the plate and pegs
D2.description: The plate shifts over the white fixture. The pegs move within the plate’s openings as its alignment is adjusted.
D2.cameraHint: Compare the peg positions in cam_1 and cam_2.

D3.title: Gripper release transition
D3.description: The fingers begin opening while the plate remains over the peg fixture. The sharp dip coincides with this change in grasp state.
D3.cameraHint: Use cam_1 or cam_2 to watch the fingers open; cam_0 shows the fixture.

D1.title: Reorientation over the board
D1.description: The RAM stays in the gripper while its orientation changes above the motherboard. The dip coincides with this rotation during approach.
D1.cameraHint: Use cam_1 for the RAM orientation and cam_0 for its relation to the board.

D2.title: Adjustment at the slot
D2.description: A brief pose adjustment occurs with the RAM near the slot. Compare the peak and trough to inspect the alignment change and visible motion blur.
D2.cameraHint: Compare cam_0 and cam_2; cam_1 shows the RAM above the slot.
